name: Dumbbell Renegade Row
steps: Set two flat-sided dumbbells beneath your shoulders, grip them firmly, and step back into a wide-foot plank.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to lock your body in a straight line.
Press down firmly through one dumbbell as you row the other elbow back toward your hip.
Lower that dumbbell softly to the floor under control and alternate arms.
tips: Keep both hip bones pointing straight at the floor without twisting.
Use stable flat-sided dumbbells and widen your feet for extra anti-rotation stability.
